headline: CROP portal and process reforms (FIFO disposal, two-factor login, no legal-section step after KYC), a new biopesticide filing flow with NBAIM, firm TI-New Source rules, export-only supply permissions, and new committees on insecticide + herbicide combinations and bio-efficacy protocols.

changes.t: Process reforms from the AS(PP) review
changes.d: 9(3) and 9(4) TIM applications of KYC-complete applicants no longer go to the legal section. Two-factor login becomes mandatory for applicants and experts. Experts must dispose of files first-in-first-out. Pending cases get a final public/newspaper notice, then cancellation. CGG to revamp the CROP portal.

changes.t: Biopesticides: new filing flow with NBAIM
changes.d: File the application on CROP first and pay the fee; then send a 500 g sample to ICAR-NBAIM (Mau) for 16S rDNA fingerprinting and a 500 g sample to CIL, each quoting the CROP application number, within 30 days. A public notice followed (14.10.2026).

changes.t: TI-New Source: revised guidelines apply to everyone
changes.d: An RTT permit gives no right to the old guidelines. Meenakshi Agro's request to be judged under pre-10.10.2025 rules was rejected; the revised TI-New Source data requirements apply.
A committee under ADG (PP-B), ICAR will frame guidelines. Applicants may withdraw (fee kept for a future application) or keep the file in abeyance until then.
A committee under ADG (PP&BS) will review the 9(3) bio-efficacy protocol.

changes.t: Export-only: technical may be supplied within India
changes.d: Superform may supply Asulam and Fenhexamid technical to UPL, and Deccan Fine Chemicals may supply Tiapyrachlor to Corteva, only to make export-only formulations; nothing may be sold in India.

Before changing the Export Only / Import for Export rules, CropLife India must present its proposal and safeguards against leakage into the Indian market. (Decided in the 477th meeting: new Category B-V.)

changes.t: Lab data may be verified on site
changes.d: A CIB&RC expert with an NGCMA officer (GLP labs), or two CIB&RC officers (NABL labs), may inspect labs to verify study data case by case.
CIB&RC will report on the legal position of linking CROP KYC with the GST portal at the next meeting.
Tebuconazole (Kashma Agro) and Pyraclostrobin (S.D. Agro Chemicals) were rejected for the second time on unsatisfactory CIL reports; no further chance.

A meeting with FSSAI's SPPR and stakeholders will settle the crop grouping document. The Indoxacarb composition committee was reconstituted under Dr Poonam Jasrotia (report in 15 days; decided in the 477th meeting).
Saraswati Agrochemicals must justify a WHO class 1b (red triangle) molecule and address the NDMA impurity at the next meeting.

actions: Biopesticide applicants: file on CROP first, then send samples to NBAIM and CIL within 30 days, quoting the application number.
Complete KYC on CROP so files skip the legal section.
Set up two-factor login on CROP when it is switched on.
TI-New Source: prepare data to the revised guidelines, whatever the RTT date.
Insecticide + herbicide combination files: choose to withdraw or keep in abeyance.
